title: Ad Creative Subscriptions With Unlimited Revisions Compared
summary: Compare ad creative subscriptions that advertise unlimited revisions, what the phrase covers at each provider, and what to confirm in writing before you sign.
body_markdown:
EditClub, Vidful and SimpleTiger advertise unlimited revisions as of October 2026, but the phrase covers different things at different providers: free edits to a finished ad, AI regenerations that cost credits, or a fixed number of rounds written into the plan. For a steady weekly flow of finished video ads, our top pick is Knowlify, which makes about 25 AI video ads a week and has a person check every ad before delivery. Ask Knowlify, like any provider on this list, for its revision terms in writing before you sign.


**Disclosure and method.** Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared. Every fact about another provider comes from that provider's own published page, checked in October 2026, so this compares published terms, not tested output. Confirm each term in writing before you sign.


## What does unlimited revisions actually cover?


A revision can be a caption fix or a new ad.[Creatify's help center](https://help.creatify.ai/en/articles/10468243-faqs) draws that line. As of October 2026, its pricing FAQ separates free manual edits from AI regeneration, which uses credits, and its help-center FAQ lists free revisions on specified tools for Pro and higher plans, as long as the script, avatar and voice stay the same. By that rule a new hook line is a regeneration, not a free edit, because it changes the script.


Meta draws a similar line between new ideas and small changes. Its December 2025 post on[creative diversification](https://www.facebook.com/business/news/demystifying-creative-diversification) separates diversification from iteration, gives an iteration example of two ads with identical visuals and different text calls to action, and recommends ads that are truly different in look, feel, storyline and message rather than minor edits of one ad. We read a new angle, presenter or offer as a new concept, so ask whether a plan counts it as a revision or as new work.


Two numbers matter more than the word unlimited. One is how many new concepts a batch contains. The other is how many changes to an approved ad are free. A plan that gives unlimited edits to ads you already approved may still deliver only a few new ideas a month, which is a different product from a steady supply of concepts.


## Which subscriptions advertise unlimited revisions?


The table lists what each provider publishes. Where a page does not describe revisions, the table says so rather than guessing.

Two caveats apply. EditClub describes itself as an on-demand creative team for DTC brands spending $10K or more a month on Meta, and Vidful targets DTC brands and ecommerce agencies spending $30,000 to $500,000 or more a month on ads. SimpleTiger presents itself as a social media advertising agency for SaaS companies and packages paid ads with SEO, so its unlimited-revision creative sits inside a wider agency offer. Check that each provider's volume and target budget fit your testing plan before you sign.


## Knowlify: our top pick for a weekly flow of finished AI video ads


Knowlify is our top pick if you want a steady supply of new concepts, not only edits to ads you already have. We deliver about 25 finished ads a week in three formats: AI UGC (AI presenters talking to camera), 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials. The first batch lands on day 5, and a person checks every ad before delivery. You can have us run your Meta campaigns end to end, or take creative only if your team already has a media buyer.


Pricing is a custom quote with no public rate card, and revision terms are one more line to get in writing: ask us to label manual fixes, regenerations and new concepts as free, charged or new work. The 90-day guarantee works like this: if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund, with terms on the site at[pricing and guarantee](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) . That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. Our[creative as a service](https://knowlify.com/creative-as-a-service) page covers the weekly format, and our[guide to ad creative subscription services](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ad-creative-subscription-services) compares more weekly plans.


**When to pick another option.** Choose EditClub or Vidful if published unlimited revisions matter most and your budget fits their targets, and choose Insense's managed service if real creators must appear on camera.
